x-note: algebraic-intelligence.dev is the chronicle, not the grimoire. The skills — the datamancy wards, Latin-named code-review disciplines, each a SKILL.md you cast as a subagent against a target file or tree — live at datamancy.dev and are served from a single KMS-signed (ECDSA P-256 over SHA-256) manifest: the authoritative, always-current, content-addressed catalog. This site deliberately holds no copy. A mirror drifts (a stale count, a stale digest, a list that rots when a spell is added); the signed source cannot. Fetch the live catalog at x-authoritative-source, or the signed manifest at x-manifest (verify against x-manifest-signature; the public key is pinned in the npm package source at https://www.npmjs.com/package/datamancy). Adding a spell never changes this file. To use a ward: fetch its SKILL.md, verify its SHA-256 against the signed manifest, then embed it into a subagent's prompt and name the target — the spell is cast by value, never fetched by the worker.
